**Canada: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 1,285,767 applications. The largest annual volume was 188,145 in 2024; 2025 recorded 133,910. Applications in 2025 were 91% higher than in 2019 (70,140). In 2025, 96,789 recorded decisions equated to 72 per 100 applications, so recorded output fell below incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 29% lower than in 2024 (188,145). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 4 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were India (21,109), Haiti (18,231), Nigeria (8,118).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 67%, across 78,997 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 18% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 3.1 percentage points lower than in 2024 (70%).
